description: This file defines an interface for AV Input management within the WPEFramework. It includes nested structures, enums, notification interfaces, and method declarations for configuring inputs, handling notifications, retrieving and setting EDID parameters, managing video and signal status, and querying supported features. The interface is designed for interaction with HDMI and Composite input devices, providing capabilities for device monitoring, configuration, and status updates.

classes.name: IAVInput
classes.description: Interface for managing AV input devices and their notifications, including configuration, status updates, device management, and feature queries.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the AV input device with the provided service context.

methods.name: RegisterDevicesChangedNotification
methods.description: Registers a callback to notify when input devices change.

methods.name: UnregisterDevicesChangedNotification
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered device change notification callback.

methods.name: RegisterSignalChangedNotification
methods.description: Registers a callback to notify when signal status changes.

methods.name: UnregisterSignalChangedNotification
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered signal change notification callback.

methods.name: RegisterInputStatusChangedNotification
methods.description: Registers a callback for input status change notifications.

methods.name: UnregisterInputStatusChangedNotification
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered input status change notification callback.

methods.name: RegisterVideoStreamInfoUpdateNotification
methods.description: Registers a callback for video stream info updates.

methods.name: UnregisterVideoStreamInfoUpdateNotification
methods.description: Unregisters a video stream info update notification callback.

methods.name: RegisterGameFeatureStatusUpdateNotification
methods.description: Registers a callback for game feature status changes.

methods.name: UnregisterGameFeatureStatusUpdateNotification
methods.description: Unregisters a game feature status update notification callback.

methods.name: RegisterAviContentTypeUpdateNotification
methods.description: Registers a callback for AV content type updates.

methods.name: UnregisterAviContentTypeUpdateNotification
methods.description: Unregisters an AV content type update callback.

methods.name: NumberOfInputs
methods.description: Retrieves the total number of available AV input sources.

methods.name: WriteEDID
methods.description: Writes a new EDID configuration to a specified input port.

methods.name: ReadEDID
methods.description: Reads the current EDID data from a specified input port.

methods.name: GetRawSPD
methods.description: Retrieves raw SPD infoFrame data for a given HDMI port.

methods.name: GetSPD
methods.description: Retrieves parsed SPD infoFrame data for a specific HDMI port.

methods.name: SetEdidVersion
methods.description: Sets the EDID version for a specified port.

methods.name: GetEdidVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the EDID version of a specified port.

methods.name: SetEdid2AllmSupport
methods.description: Sets the Allm support bit in the EDID for a port.

methods.name: GetEdid2AllmSupport
methods.description: Retrieves the Allm support status from the EDID.

methods.name: SetVRRSupport
methods.description: Sets the VRR support bit in the EDID for a port.

methods.name: GetVRRSupport
methods.description: Retrieves the VRR support status from the EDID.

methods.name: GetHdmiVersion
methods.description: Gets the maximum HDMI version supported on a port.

methods.name: SetMixerLevels
methods.description: Adjusts the audio mixer levels.

methods.name: StartInput
methods.description: Activates a specified input port with options for audio and video configuration.

methods.name: StopInput
methods.description: Deactivates the current primary input.

methods.name: SetVideoRectangle
methods.description: Configures the position and size of the video input window.

methods.name: CurrentVideoMode
methods.description: Gets the current video mode for the active input.

methods.name: ContentProtected
methods.description: Checks if the current input is content protected.

methods.name: GetSupportedGameFeatures
methods.description: Retrieves a list of supported game-related features.

methods.name: GetGameFeatureStatus
methods.description: Gets the status of a specific game feature, such as ALLM.

methods.name: GetVRRFrameRate
methods.description: Retrieves the current VRR frame rate for a port.
